title: Rippers Unmasked — Guise
description: The Guise (mask / identity swap) as a first-class Project FU classFeature, on the Arcanist Arcanum pattern: hold several guises, bind one to make it active (dismissing any other), and its embedded ActiveEffect deltas apply on swap. Registers 'guise' on FU's module-open classFeature registry — no system fork. Original campaign content. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

recommends.reason: The Bonds tab renders Deeper Bonds natively via its API when present; without it the tab shows a plain read-only bond list.

rippers-guise.note: v0.7.37 (Austin ruling — the INNATE / Human form has NO affinity trio by design, NOT a owed hole): the play surface previously flagged ANY guise with no affinityModifiers as TRIO — NOT IN OUR BOOKS (red owed). But the innate/Human form is not distilled from a monster, so having no affinity trio is a LEGITIMATE empty state, not an unrecorded gap. buildGuisePlayVM now gates affinityTrioOwed to NON-innate guises (a DISTILLED/worn guise with a genuinely unrecorded trio keeps the red owed note); the innate form gets innateNoTrio → a neutral muted Innate form - no affinity trio label instead of the red warning. Affinities still render all-neutral either way. The MODEL/validation already did NOT flag the innate form (validateGuiseDraft gates the trio check to mode==='worn'), so no model change was needed. Also confirmed (Austin): the v0.7.36 innate-effects lifecycle stands as shipped — innate-form effects active only while the innate form is active (displaced under a mask, restored on unmask); NOT always-on. Only the innate form affinity-trio rendering/owed-flagging changed; distilled guises unchanged. Tests 193 (updated the affinity-trio test: worn+unrecorded → owed, innate → not owed + innateNoTrio). Art-free. No Forge — Austin confirms the Human form shows neutral affinities with no owed warning. --- v0.7.36 (feature — the INNATE guise can now carry attachable effects too; Austin): the attached-effects layer (materialiseAttachedEffects on bind / strip on dismiss — the same machinery that rides lent-HP/MP + attribute die-bump effects onto the actor) was authored only on WORN/distilled guises. The INNATE guise now gets it too, reusing the EXISTING mechanism (no parallel path). Two editor-only gaps closed: (1) guiseDraftToData INNATE branch was silently dropping draft.attachedEffects — now carries them (same normalised {itemUuid} shape as worn); (2) the guise-editor Loadout step now renders the attached-effects drop zone in INNATE mode (was worn-only), reusing the shared drop-dispatch (data-guise-drop=attachedEffect), remove action, and loadout VM. NO engine change needed: the innate guise is the active guise while unmasked and binds through the same _bindCore, so its attached effects materialise on bind exactly like a worn guise. LIFECYCLE CHOICE (my call, matches god lean, consistent with innate gear/skills): DISPLACED-WHILE-MASKED / RESTORED-ON-UNMASK — wearing a mask dismisses the innate guise and _dismissCore strips its owned set (incl. attached effects); unmasking re-binds and re-materialises. Falls out of the existing bind/dismiss machinery for free. (Always-on persistence is deliberately NOT this path: character-level/quirk effects already persist across swaps separately; flagged, not assumed.) Tests 191->193. Art-free. No Forge — Austin attaches an effect to the innate guise and confirms it applies while unmasked, drops under a mask. --- v0.7.35 (TOP-PRIORITY save-regression FIX — sheet save threw DataModelValidationError: name undefined + system.attributes.*.base non-integer): ROOT CAUSE — the actor sheet extends DocumentSheetV2 (via ActorSheetV2), which defaults to tag:form + native auto-submit. But this sheet saves EXCLUSIVELY through its own data-edit / data-idfield / data-bond change writers (each does document.update({[path]: coerced-value})), and its editable controls carry NO name= attribute. So the inherited native form submission serialised garbage — name:undefined (no name= field) and attributes.*.base as  (non-integer) — and threw on validate. The custom writers were always the intended sole save path; the native submit was latent liability that a control on the default-open tab tripped. FIX (two layers, no behaviour change to the writers): (1) DEFAULT_OPTIONS.form = { submitOnChange:false, closeOnSubmit:false } — a native change no longer auto-submits; (2) _onSubmitForm() overridden to a no-op — an explicit submit (Enter in a text input, a stray submit event) can never fire the default serialiser either. The data-edit change writers are unchanged and remain the only save path. Also extracted the writer coercion to a pure editFieldUpdate(path, raw, dtype) — number dtype yields a finite number (the attribute-base <select> options are die sizes → integers) or SKIPS (blank/invalid → null, never writes 0/), a string field is always a DEFINED string (name never undefined) — and added a regression test asserting name defined + attributes.{mig,dex,ins,wlp}.base integer + invalid skipped. Tests 190->191. Guise builder + benefit picker (separate ApplicationV2s with their own form handlers) untouched. Art-free. No Forge here — Austin verifies edit+save round-trips with no throw. --- v0.7.34 (guise editor — editable ALL EQUIPMENT SLOTS + removed the vestigial Use-equipment toggle; Austin): (1) EXPANDED the v0.7.33 armor picker to EVERY slot — a dropdown per MAIN HAND / OFF HAND / ARMOUR / ACCESSORY in the editor Loadout step (worn guises), each populated with the matching item types (mainHand=weapon; offHand=weapon/shield; armor=armor; accessory=accessory) from every equip-eligible Item (world + Item compendia — source-agnostic, no pack name invented) + a — None — option. Selecting one atomically REPLACES that slot single entry (setDraftEquip; never doubles); the current pick is pre-selected and preserved even if the enumeration misses it. The materialise-on-bind/strip-on-dismiss mechanic is UNCHANGED for every slot (still no dup, clean unequip); a change applies on next equip (the editor already requires a worn guise be dismissed to edit, and a worn loadout re-materialises on the next bind). The drag-drop equipment zone still works below as a secondary path. So Austin can low-friction swap Proof Plate (or the weapon/shield/accessory) on Monster of Wounded Knee. (2) REMOVED the Use-equipment checkbox from the Kit/inventory tab — it was VESTIGIAL: system.useEquipment.value is an NPC-only FU field (gates NPC equipment tables + NPC weapon resolution; verified in FoundryVTT-Fabula-Ultima-dev npc-data-model.mjs + actor-standard-sheet.mjs + weapon-resolver.mjs), the FU CHARACTER model has NO such field, and the Rippers sheet is for PCs — nothing on the PC path consumed it. Removed the control, its VM field, the toggle action+handler, the lang key, and its CSS. New helpers collectEquipItems + setDraftEquip (pure) + EQUIP_SLOT_TYPES; collectArmorItems/setDraftArmor kept as back-compat wrappers. Tests 188->190. Template + wiring + lang. Art-free. No Forge here — Austin eyeballs. --- v0.7.33 (feature — EDITABLE ARMOR PICKER in the guise editor; Austin: a guise armor was fixed at distillation with no way to change it, e.g. swapping Monster of Wounded Knee Proof Plate): a worn guise armor lives as an equipment[] entry with slot armor, which materialiseEquipment already creates+equips on bind and _dismissCore strips on dismiss — that mechanic is CORRECT and UNCHANGED (Austin confirmed it does not double and unequips cleanly). The only gap was that the CHOICE was not user-editable (equipment was drag-drop only). Added an ARMOR DROPDOWN to the guise editor Loadout step (worn guises): options are every armor-type Item available (world items + all Item compendia — the source-agnostic superset of any basic-armors pack, so no pack name is invented), plus a — None (unarmored) — option; the current armor is pre-selected (and preserved even if the enumeration misses it, so an existing choice is never silently dropped). Selecting one atomically REPLACES the guise single armor entry via setDraftArmor (removes any existing slot:armor entry first — never doubles; the v0.7.23 discipline); None clears it. Works for EXISTING guises (guiseDataToDraft round-trips equipment, so the dropdown shows and edits the current armor). Applies on next equip — the editor already requires a worn guise be dismissed before editing (dismiss-before-edit guard), and a worn guise loadout re-materialises on the next bind, so the new armor appears when Austin re-wears the guise (no live hot-swap = non-fragile, no doubling). Generalises to weapon/shield/accessory as a fast-follow (same pattern), armor only for now per Austin. Helpers collectArmorItems + setDraftArmor (pure) added + tested; tests 185->188. Template + wiring + lang (Armor/ArmorNone/ArmorHint). Art-free. No Forge here — Austin eyeballs. --- v0.7.32 (play-surface polish — attribute DICE now readable; Austin screenshot on v0.7.29): the dice in the character summary strip were unreadable — a near-black fill on the near-black bg with the value crammed inside a rotated diamond/kite (d10 colliding with the clipped edges). ROOT CAUSE: the clip-path was on the element that HELD the number, so the polygon clipped the glyph AND clipped the border away. FIX (rep call a — upright value + outlined silhouette): the die is now a two-layer OUTLINED SILHOUETTE (a bone-dim edge + a raised --card2 interior via a clipped ::after) that separates from the bg and clips ONLY itself; the value sits UPRIGHT on top (z-index 1), mono 15px bone/cream, uncramped and high-contrast — the number is the hero. Shape cues kept (d6 square, d8 diamond, d10 kite, d12 hex) with the MIG/DEX/INS/WLP label under. Effect-moved state is a small corner ▲/▼ + a coloured edge (green up / red down), not a glyph jammed inside the shape. Attribute dice chips only. Template + CSS (VM unchanged); tests 185/185. Art-free. No Forge here — Austin eyeballs vs the screenshot. --- v0.7.31 (play-surface polish — ARMOR—WORN card is now ONE ROW; Austin screenshot on v0.7.29): the card duplicated its numbers (line 1 formula 'DEF +12 · M.DEF INS+0', line 2 'WORN: DEF 12 · M.DEF 6') and showed noise fragments (+12, INS+0). Now a single row: name + MARTIAL tag + the gold WORN TOTALS only (e.g. 'the Proof Plate [MARTIAL] · DEF 12 · M.DEF 6'). Dropped the separate WORN line and the derivation-formula fragments; worn totals are the single readout, gold as before. ARMOR—WORN card ONLY — no other section touched. Template + CSS only (VM unchanged); tests 185/185. Art-free. No Forge here — Austin eyeballs. --- v0.7.30 (SPELL AUTO-MATERIALIZATION — guise half of a COORDINATED release with rippers-compendium v0.4.3; Austin ruling: spells attach to the GUISE, picked when you take the granting skill, materialise on bind, strip on dismiss): (1) SCHEMA — a spellcasting skill entry now carries spellUuids[] (the picked spells), linked to the granting skill; empty for a non-caster skill. (2) PICKER — the guise editor Skills step shows, under a spellcasting granting skill with SL>0, a spell picker: choose up to SL spells from that skill discipline list (elemental_magic→elementalism, entropic_magic→entropism, etc.), capped at SL, with a live picked/cap count. The available spells come from the compendium spells pack (grantingSkillKey match on the skill fuid) — no spell values duplicated in this module. (3) MATERIALIZE — new materialiseSpells(actor,item) creates the picked spells as guise-origin actor spell Items on bind (flagged origin+kind:spell, added to the owned set), so _dismissCore strips them on dismiss with the rest of the guise-origin set; capped at the skill SL. Mirrors materialiseSkills exactly. (4) CAST — materialised spells appear + cast in the v0.7.16 Spells tab (native item.roll()); no tab change needed. (5) QUIRK spells = CHARACTER-level exception: a quirk-granted spell is attached to the character (never flagged guise-origin), so it persists across swaps — handled by NOT routing it through materialiseSpells (separate path; a quirk-spell authoring surface is a follow-on, flagged). New helpers: spellsForSkill / spellGrantingSkillKeys / loadSpellIndex (index-only pack load, cached). guiseDraftToData + guiseDataToDraft round-trip spellUuids. Tests 181->185 (+4: draft carry capped at SL, data↔draft round-trip, materialise flagged+capped, spellsForSkill mapping). EDGE CASES flagged to god, none blocking: HP-cost Sin-Eater spells (FU mpCost assumes MP — cast-time deduction is an FU limitation, not a materialization issue); 5 choose/multi damage-type spells (left BLANK + ⚠ in the compendium, never invented); heroic-tagged spells materialise via their granting skill where mapped; Vivisectionist has NO static list (runtime Spell Mimic — the picker offers nothing, correctly); Dancer dances are NOT spells (structural gap — no mpCost/target, duration outside the FU enum; needs a ruling). REQUIRES rippers-compendium v0.4.3 installed (the spells pack) to resolve/cast — the guise release is inert until god gates/cuts that compendium release. Art-free. No Forge here — Austin eyeballs. --- v0.7.29 (THE GUISE play surface SKINNED + COMPLETED to Design's mockup — GUISE-PLAY-SURFACE-DESIGN-SPEC.md, 2a 'The Slash', Persona-5 interaction): the held heavy-polish pass. All 10 sections, top to bottom, from REAL resolved data — nothing invented, ⚠ holes rendered exactly as the design draws them (dashed = empty/unrecorded, green = live effect/immune, red = vulnerable/owed). NEW/changed: (1) CHARACTER SUMMARY STRIP above the guise section — name, LEVEL·TORMENT, vitals (HP+CRISIS, MP, IP, FABULA) with GREEN lent-layer deltas, and the dice row; character-level, constant across guises (sourced from the root VM's vitals/masthead — DEF/M.DEF stay guise-side per Austin). TORMENT reads a flags.rippers-guise.torment authoring hook, else the ⚠ hole (never invented). (2) ATTRIBUTES as DIE SHAPES — d6 square, d8 diamond, d10 kite (else hex), value inside + label under; character-level post-effect (.current vs .base), an effect-moved die renders green ▲ and keeps the base recoverable. (3) PREVIEW dropdown by the guise title — previews ANOTHER owned guise's readout WITHOUT binding (no Swap, no Turn), player-visible; the worn guise carries the BOUND marker; the character strip stays constant. Wired via _previewGuiseId + a change-listener; reset on tab-change and guise-wear. (4) CLASS cards — skill rows click-to-expand full rule text (the skill Item's system.description) + a SOURCE TAG (a skill-Item citation flag or system.source, rendered only when authored); an unresolvable class UUID = a dashed 'CLASS SLOT — ⚠ UNAUTHORED'; a sub-note line (therioform names etc.) renders only when authored (NO structured selection dataset exists — flagged). (5) HEROIC row — THREE slots; slot 0 = the guise's own heroic (name + click-to-expand rules + REQ line); slots 1 & 2 dashed 'HEROIC SLOT — EMPTY' (extra-heroics-on-a-bound-guise policy is UNDECIDED — Austin). (6) WHAT THIS GUISE CHANGES + ARMOR—WORN side by side — modifier chips from REAL guise data: lent HP/MP layers + IP satchel (system.data.lentHp/lentMp/ipSatchel — first-class guise state) and attribute die-bumps (current > base, green ▲ chips); armor line carries the MARTIAL tag. (7) AFFINITIES — ALL NINE elements, four states (IMMUNE green / RESISTANT tan / VULNERABLE red / neutral dashed); an unrecorded trio renders all-neutral + the red 'TRIO — ⚠ NOT IN OUR BOOKS' note. (8) BANE/TELL/PERK — innate → NONE; non-innate empty → ⚠ OWED. (9) WEAPON + EQUIPPED ('fixed at distillation') + CLOT pane (empty state 'No Clot seated.'; the seated readout is UNSPECIFIED in the spec → stubbed, flagged). (10) IDENTITY FOOTER — BOUND—UNTRADABLE (innate) or THE PHIAL—TRADABLE (non-innate; 'travels whole; bind resets on hand-off'), field limit, the Turn note. Carbolic Coat + Miracle Tonic are intentional DEMOS (Austin) — the structure renders them, their ⚠ fields stay holes. THE EFFECTS-SCHEMA QUESTION (god's one code ask) IS ANSWERED, and it's good news: the guise-scoped lent-HP/MP layer + IP satchel ALREADY EXIST as first-class guise state (ride/freeze/transfer with the Item, refill at rest, wired into the damage pipeline), and attribute die-bumps flow through FU's .current (guise-attached effects materialise on bind, strip on dismiss) — so the demo's 'Miracle Tonic +10 HP' and '▲MIG d8→d10' need NO new schema. The ONE gap: skill-derived ACC/DMG numeric mods are computed by the rules engine, not stored on a guise, so they are NOT emitted as chips (flagged); and die-bump chips reflect ALL live character effects, not strictly this guise's (precise per-guise attribution via the effect origin flag is a flagged refinement). buildGuisePlayVM reworked; tests 179->181 (+ all-nine-affinity/trio-owed + preview coverage). No Forge here — Austin eyeballs vs the mockup. --- v0.7.28 (two Austin corrections): (1) SHARED RESOLVE is DUAL-TARGET — the guise-side message now reads '+N MP — you & <bond>'; the actual dual MP recovery (holder + bonded party member) lives in rippers-deeper-bonds v0.2.4 (pair with it). (2) PLAY-SURFACE FLAVOUR LINE DROPPED — Austin doesn't want it; removed the footer flavour element (and the VM no longer surfaces the guise Nature there). Also confirmed XP auto-spend stays MANUAL (no change; v0.7.22 already manual). Tests 179/179. --- v0.7.27 (bond actions — unified ruling, guise half; PAIR with rippers-deeper-bonds v0.2.3): implements Austin's bond-action ruling ('a party-member toggle gates Status + Regen; the die-size increase is entirely emotional and presence-independent'). (1) PARTY-MEMBER toggle: a checkbox on every bond — the GM bond card AND the inline bond editor (Bonds + Edit tabs, shown only when Deeper Bonds ≥0.2.3 is present) — wired via a _onRender change-listener to Deeper Bonds' setBondPartyMember (owner-writable). (2) STATUS-RECOVER (Cleanse) + (3) SHARED RESOLVE are now shown ONLY for party-member bonds. Cover-Regen is renamed 'Shared Resolve' (button label + the sheetBondSharedResolve wrapper calls the module's new sharedResolve → holder MP recovery, once per scene, party-only; reason strings surfaced: not-party/too-weak/used-this-scene). (4) DIE-SIZE (Raise die) stays shown for ALL bonds regardless of the party toggle — emotional, presence-independent. bondPanelRow + editable.bonds carry partyMember; the toggle is gated on the Deeper Bonds API being present. Tests 179/179. This is the guise half of a coordinated release — it needs rippers-deeper-bonds v0.2.3 (which owns the party flag + sharedResolve). --- v0.7.26 (play-surface correction — attributes are DICE, not bars): Austin — FU attributes are die sizes (d6/d8/d10/d12), so a proportional stat bar misrepresents them. The play surface's four attributes now render as DIE CHIPS (DEX d8 · INS d8 · MIG d10 · WLP d6), not bars. Still CHARACTER-level (post-effect .current), with a gold tint when an effect has stepped the die up and a vuln tint when stepped down. (Per the Design-mockup heads-up, this is an interim clean 2a treatment — final skin comes when Design's play-surface mockup lands; the data/logic is complete now.) Tests 179/179. --- v0.7.25 (THE GUISE — Persona-style play surface, the main play view): a new first tab 'The Guise' (the sheet now OPENS on it) is an at-a-glance readout of the ACTIVE guise, assembled from real resolved data (nothing invented). Top to bottom: (1) CLASSES as columns, each SKILL a LOOK-CLOSER native <details> — collapsed = name + SL/max, expanded = the skill Item's own description (system.description, resolved via UUID; a skill with no description shows a gap note, never a fabricated one). (2) HEROIC banner (resolved name). (3) AFFINITIES/resistances chips (the guise trio, colour-coded good/bad). (4) ATTRIBUTE STAT BARS — CHARACTER-level per Austin's ruling: read from the actor's attributes post-effect (.current, fallback .base), constant across guises, buffed/debuffed tint from the effect delta vs base; NOT per-guise. (5) ARMOR line (equipped armor name + DEF/M.DEF formula from system.def/mdef.attribute+value) + WORN totals (system.derived.def/mdef). (6) CURRENT EQUIPMENT block (the native system.equipped slots → resolved items). (7) WEAPON/unarmed detail (reuses weaponStats). (8) BANE/TELL/PERK/Bonus cards (worn-guise fields). (9) Identity footer: BOUND/UNTRADABLE chip, FIELD LIMIT (party size + 2), and The Turn note. 2a-Slash register throughout. buildGuisePlayVM added + tested; tests 178->179. DATA GAPS FLAGGED to god (not invented): per-skill sub-notes (the mock's DYNAMOTHERIA·PTEROTHERIA under a skill) are not a modelled field — omitted; and there is no guise 'flavour line' field (the mock's 'The man, not a coat.') — the footer shows the guise's authored Nature if present, else nothing. This supersedes the thin 'show classes+skills on the card' item. --- v0.7.24 (Bonds-tab fixes, items 1 + 2 of god's 4-item batch): (1) EDIT BONDS ON THE BONDS TAB — the inline bond editor (name + the three FU emotion selects + tier chip + derived strength + add/remove rows) now appears in-place on the Bonds tab, not only the Edit tab. It reuses the same editable.bonds VM + the [data-bond-index] change delegate + the bondAddRow/bondRemove actions (v0.7.14), so it edits the character's own system.bonds directly and a new bond is fleeting by default. (2) → ETERNAL GATED ON MASKED — the promote-to-Eternal button on a solid bond is now shown only while the character is MASKED (an active guise is worn; 'masked' resolves to vm.worn = getActiveGuise(actor) set). Unmasked hides it. Items 3 (Cover-Regen rename/fix) and 4 (Status-Recover self-target) are handled separately: 3 is a report+proposal to god (needs Austin's approval, not invented), and 4 requires a rippers-deeper-bonds change (the cleanse target lives in that module) so it's staged as a coordinated cross-repo change, flagged to god. Tests 178/178 (guise-side items are template/VM reuse). --- v0.7.23 (BUGFIX — cabinet restore duplicated guises): restoring a guise from the world cabinet (world.rippers-cabinet) created the actor copy but never removed the cabinet copy, so stash→restore duplicated the guise endlessly. vaultSlotFromCabinet now does an atomic MOVE for a world-cabinet stash — create the actor Item, THEN delete the cabinet source — mirroring vaultStashToCabinet (create-in-cabinet + delete-from-actor). Guards: the source is deleted only AFTER the actor create succeeds; if the delete fails (e.g. a non-GM lacks world-compendium delete rights) the just-created actor copy is ROLLED BACK and the restore is refused with 'ask your GM' — so a guise is never lost and never doubled. The SHIPPED read-only library pack (rippers-guise.guises, template guises) is still COPIED, not moved — its entries are a library, not consumed (source distinguished by doc.pack). Stash direction sanity-checked: vaultStashToCabinet already creates-in-cabinet then deletes the actor copy (guarded by the create's try/catch) — correct, no mirror duplication. Tests +3 (world restore MOVES → actor 1 / cabinet 0; library slot COPIES → library intact; delete-failure rolls back → net-zero, refused). Tests 175->178. --- v0.7.22 (Edit-tab advancement layout — two Austin nits): (1) the four attributes (DEX/INS/MIG/WLP) now render on ONE line — their grid was changed from auto-fit minmax(120px) (which wrapped to 2×2) to a fixed 4-column grid (.rs-attr-grid). (2) LEVEL moved OFF the attributes area into a new ADVANCEMENT cluster (.rs-advance) that pairs Level + the Level Up button + an XP tracker on one row, so advancement reads as one group. XP uses the REAL FU path system.resources.exp.value (NumberField, min 0 — verified against the FU character data model; not invented) and moved out of the FP/EXP/Zenit grid to avoid duplication. XP is DISPLAY + manual level control only — leveling does NOT auto-spend XP: the FU data model has no coded XP→level threshold, so the auto-spend mechanic (base FU is 10 XP/level, but that isn't in the schema) is flagged to god as ⚠ owed rather than invented. Level Up still does the manual increment + L20/40 attribute-milestone prompt. Palette unchanged. Tests 175/175 (layout-only). --- v0.7.21 (Form-tab guise CARD density — Austin's live eyeball of the v0.7.18 retheme: 'better but still a lot of dark red space'): tightened the guise cards so the dark-red card ground (#120a0c) isn't left as empty panel around sparse content. SPACING/FILL ONLY, palette + fonts unchanged. Changes: .rs-tbody min-height 300px→0 (it was forcing a tall empty block under short content) + gap 12→8 + padding trimmed; .rs-classcard is now a tight flex column (padding 14px→9/12, gap 5px, child top-margins zeroed so blocks pack under one rhythm instead of scattered 8px margins); the red Heroic slab shrunk (padding 10/22→6/16, name 22→18px); face-row margins 8→4. Cards now fit their content. Tests 175/175 (CSS-only). --- v0.7.20 (Tier-1 #4 — LEVEL UP; Austin ruled the simple model): the Edit tab now shows the character Level with a direct edit AND a guided 'Level Up' button. Level Up increments system.level.value by 1; on REACHING an FU attribute milestone (level 20 or 40) it prompts to raise ONE attribute die a size (player's choice, cap d12 — FU dice ladder 6/8/10/12; d20 Apex is a class feature, not a level milestone). HOPLOSPHERE SOCKETS auto-follow with NO extra wiring: baseSocketCapacity() and persistentSlotsUnlocked() DERIVE socket counts from charLevelForHost()/system.level.value live (WEAPON 1 +1@L10/20/30→4; ARMOR 0 +1@L10/20/30→3; PERSISTENT 2 total @L40/L50) — this is god's case (a), sockets are computed, never stored, so setting the level value is all that's needed and the canon socket cadence updates itself. Skill budget (min(level,30)) is likewise derived. NOTE on socket UI: the socket-capacity ENGINE exists (baseSocketCapacity/persistentSlotsUnlocked/hoplosphereSocketCapacity/slotHoplosphere) but there is no dedicated socket-management TAB on the sheet yet — that is the separate HOPLOSPHERE-ECONOMY workstream; level-up correctly sets the level those formulas read. Pure helpers raiseDieSize + levelUpMilestone added + tested (incl. the L20 milestone raising a chosen attribute d10→d12); tests 171->175. NEXT: spell auto-materialization scoping (Austin ruled auto-stamp on bind). --- v0.7.19 (Tier-2 P5c — CLOSES P5): the character's Quirks are now settable from the guise editor. god ruled (from canon, no Austin needed) that quirks are PER-CHARACTER, not per-guise (creation Step 8 Keystone/Quirk; already character-owned 'effect' Items on the Quirk tab since v0.7.11; C4 = quirks stack) — so NO per-guise quirk model was invented. Module then STANDS BY: Tier-3 (Study roll, Rituals/Projects) and Level-Up are held pending Austin's rulings. --- v0.7.18 (Tier-2 P5 — guise-editor pass, part 1): (IN-CONTEXT OPEN, owed item) every guise card on the Form tab now has an Edit button that opens the themed GuiseBuilderApp in-context (data-action=openEditor → sheetOpenEditor → openGuiseBuilder; dismiss-before-edit per G3), instead of only the Edit-tab mini-panel — no stray raw item window.
